# An invoice settled twice: once by naming a deposit the book already holds,
# with nothing but the account and the guid, and once by an ordinary payment
# that states its own date and amount.
#
# The two block shapes are what this fixture is for. A retarget names a
# movement the book has, so the block does not restate it; an ordinary payment
# describes one to be made, so it must. Comparing a retarget block as though it
# were an ordinary one reads fields it was never required to carry.
customer "C-BARE"
	name: "Acme Bare"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-BARE"
	customer_id: "C-BARE"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-02
		due: 2026-03-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-BARE"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-20
		amount: 60
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "The rest of it"
